quest.title: Danger? Keep Away!
quest.description: Sandrone seems to be looking for us...

talks.objective: Head to the aquarium on the lower level

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why does Paimon feel like there's an extra pool here all of a sudden? What does that sign say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Danger — Keep Away!" What does that mean?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It means exactly what it says.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wah! Sandrone... You made Paimon jump! Did you put this sign here?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Yes. With the intention of keeping any curious cats well away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's so special about this pool?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It's full of piranhas.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha—!?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Haha, just kidding. Don't tell me you actually believed that?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I learned that a few fish in the aquarium are highly territorial and can get rather aggressive. So, I moved them here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't scare Paimon like that! So, this place is like a special quarantine zone for aggro fishies?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Exactly, the water in this pool is much deeper, and there's a lot more space. It helps calm down the more territorial fish.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I also asked Sigewinne at the Fortress of Meropide for some special bait to help mellow them out a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, wow... So, you really do care about the fishies' well-being!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I don't think anyone wants to see the aquarium turn into a blood bath.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's for sure! Anyway, why don't you leave this to us?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: If you insist. When the fish in the pool feel comfortable enough to swim to the surface, it means they're on the mend.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So once they're all relaxed and happy, we can put them back in the aquarium?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Where you put them is up to you. All I'm responsible for is scooping up the unruly ones and moving them here in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Understood! But that sign is way too scary. Maybe we can change it for something a little less... terrifying?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmm... If you want. They're your fish, so I'll leave it up to you.
